ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that: (a) for a period of 90 days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (b) for a period of 12 months following delivery, the Interface, all related software and all deliverables will conform to their documentation; (c) the Interface and all related software will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and other malicious code; and (d) TrueLink will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Interface, software, deliverable or services.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so TrueLink stands behind neither the Interface nor the Hosting and Support Services. We have added our standard performance warranty (professional and workmanlike Services for 90 days, 12-month conformance of software and deliverables to documentation, no malicious code, compliance with laws) with a repair, replacement or refund remedy.
